title: Study Buddy: laptop <-> ESP32 device protocol
description:
JSON Lines, one JSON object per line, 115200 baud. Transport is USB serial now and Bluetooth SPP later; every outgoing line is written to all transports and every incoming line feeds one shared handler. Both ends ignore non-JSON lines and unknown fields, so debug prints on the same link are safe. The device assembler drops lines over 256 bytes.

Message directions: laptop -> device: config, start, drift, focus, peek, end. Device -> laptop: hello, start, state, end, circle. The device reports only relevant session changes, never raw knob or touch input. The two 'start' pairs and the two 'end' pairs share one t on opposite directions; they are distinguished by their fields (see defs).

Ownership: the laptop is the source of truth for screen and idle activity and for the session goal (the goal stays on the laptop and is not sent). The device is the source of truth for session state, drift, XP, level and pet identity: the laptop reports what it sees (drift for site/idle, focus for camera telemetry from ML-Server-Pomo) and the device decides what counts as a drift and reports it back in state. level/xp/hearts are never sent laptop -> device.

String lengths: maxLength values are the device's limits in UTF-8 bytes. JSON Schema counts characters, so the limits are exact for ASCII only; the device cuts longer or multi-byte strings at a character boundary.

config.description: Laptop -> device. Pet/user config, sent at coupling and on resync. Only given fields are applied; omitted pet fields keep the current value.

user.description: Student name, shown on the boot screen.

time.description: Current epoch seconds, used to set the device clock.

tz.description: UTC offset in minutes, east positive.

start_laptop.description: Laptop -> device. Starts a study set when no phase is running. The device snaps study to 15/25/45/60 and clamps brk to the allowed range (15 -> 3..5, 25 -> 5..8, 45 -> 9..15, 60 -> 12..20). A start while a phase is running is ignored.

study.description: Study minutes; snapped to the nearest of 15/25/45/60 on the device.

brk.description: Break minutes; clamped to 1/5..1/3 of the snapped study length on the device.

drift.description: Laptop -> device. Reports screen (kind site) or idle (kind idle) activity the laptop sees. active:true with a label starts it; active:false ends it and clears the label. Camera drift is not sent this way: the device derives it from focus messages. The device keeps this laptop drift and its own camera drift as separate sources and is drifting while either is active (see state). A minute with 15+ seconds of drift is a drift minute. Drift only scores during study.

label.description: What drifted, e.g. 'YouTube', 'Idle'. Shown on the device and echoed in state.drift.

kind.description: Echoed back in state.drift_kind; the device scores both kinds the same.

focus.description:
Laptop -> device. Camera focus telemetry from ML-Server-Pomo (python -m pomo, webcam face analyzer). The server prints one JSON object per tick on stdout at --hz (default 2 Hz) without a t field; the laptop adds t:'focus' and forwards each line unchanged otherwise while a session is running.

The device owns camera drift. Ticks are ignored outside the study phase. A camera drift starts after 10 s of continuous 'unfocused' or 'drifting' ticks and ends after 3 s of continuous 'focused' ticks, or when no focus tick has arrived for 5 s (server stopped). 'calibrating' ticks neither start nor end a drift. While a camera drift is active its label comes from reason: absent -> 'Away', drowsy -> 'Drowsy', looking_away -> 'Looking away', slouching -> 'Slouching', bad_window -> 'Off task', null -> 'Camera'. yaw/pitch/ear/window/focus are diagnostic and not used by the device.

reason.description: Highest-priority active reason; null when none.

window.description: Active window category from ML-Server-Pomo's window source (config/windows.yaml); 'neutral' until a real source lands.

ear.description: Mean eye aspect ratio; below ~0.20 reads as drowsy.

peek.description: Laptop -> device. Lights the nixie timer on the device for 5 s. No fields.

end_laptop.description:
Laptop -> device. 'End break' and 'End session' buttons.

scope 'break': only during break or long_rest; ends it now. After a break the next study session starts (device sends start_device); after the long rest the set is over and the device goes idle (device sends state with phase idle). Ignored while studying or idle.

scope 'session': ends the whole set and goes idle. While studying, the session is scored first (partial last minute not counted) and the device sends end_device with early:true, then state with phase idle. During break or long_rest nothing is scored and the device sends state with phase idle. Ignored while idle.

hello.description: Device -> laptop. Sent once when the link task starts and whenever a laptop connects over Bluetooth (coupling handshake). fw is the firmware version.

start_device.description: Device -> laptop. Sent when a study session begins (session I, after each break, and when a break is ended early). Values are the snapped/clamped lengths the device is actually running.

state.description: Device -> laptop. Current session state, once per second while study/break/long rest runs and once when returning to idle. The device owns the countdown and the drift decision; the dashboard follows both. left/total are the remaining and total seconds of the current phase (0 when idle).

focus.description: drift while any drift source (laptop site/idle, device camera) is active.

drift.description: Label of the drift shown, '' when none. When both sources are active the laptop drift is shown.

drift_kind.description: Source of the drift shown, '' when none.

drift_s.description: Seconds the device has been drifting (any source) without a break.

mult.description: Effective circle multiplier right now (1 while anyone in the circle drifts).

end_device.description: Device -> laptop. Final result when a study session is scored: when study time runs out, or when it is ended mid-study (end_laptop scope 'session' or knob hold on the device). Not sent when a break or long rest is ended. xp is the delta (may be -10); total_xp is the running total afterwards. penalty is true when pct < 50 after at least a full minute: no XP earned and -10 XP, never below the current level's floor.

early.description: True when the session ended before study time ran out (partial last minute not counted); the device is idle afterwards.

circle.description: Device -> laptop. Study circle from ESP-NOW, sent when the set of nearby friends changes (including to empty). Friends are other Study Buddy devices in the circle; pct is their last session's focus percent (0 while mid-session). Up to 4 friends are tracked.

focused.description: Whether the friend's device is focused (not drifting) right now.
